CustomField.description: THE ORG'S OWN ANSWER, and it wins whenever it is set. Blank means the shipped default stands. A separate field rather than an edit to the default, so that what WE shipped and what the CUSTOMER decided stay legible as two different facts - the same reason AAO_Setting__mdt and AAO_People_Question__mdt keep theirs apart, and the reason an org that upgrades does not silently lose its own decision.
CustomField.label: Org Override
